title: PAINT issue: PTN002500132

author: marcfeuermann
body:
CC annotations for this family are so confusing. There is more evidence for plasma membrane, but we have also cell surface, extracellular, cell wall... and many intracellular compartments. In total, there are over 120 distinct primary CC annotations for the whole family, which is unusual.
Let's be cautious and follow your suggestion.
